Play the story game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · STORY SEQUENCING

Squirrel’s Mixed-Up Morning

Squirrel’s morning is mixed up! Tap the pictures in story order: first, next, then, and last.

Tap Squirrel’s morning in order — first to last.

Morning fixed!

Wake up, brush, breakfast, off to school — a perfect morning order.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains story sequencing on the story picture itself: the questions are spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to say the answer out loud before tapping — the retelling is where comprehension really grows.

Prefer paper? The Squirrel’s Mixed-Up Morning worksheet prints the same story with room to retell and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
